name: Funds sent to unlicensed or weakly regulated exchanges
description: Withdrawals or flows go to exchanges or VASPs that lack licensing or effective AML and sanctions controls.
fp: Some legitimate smaller platforms are not yet registered or are licensed in other regimes.

links.name: Cash-out to high-risk or unregistered exchanges
links.ctx: Withdrawals go to addresses attributed to exchanges that lack licensing or effective AML controls.

links.name: Funds sent to unlicensed or weakly regulated exchanges
links.ctx: Consolidated proceeds are sent to exchanges, OTC desks or platforms with weak licensing or AML controls, enabling off-ramp into fiat or further layering.

links.name: Exposure to non-compliant exchanges in sanctioned or high-risk locations
links.ctx: Funds flow to or from VASPs known for weak sanctions controls.
